original_text:
Databricks Auto Loader can now clean up processed files automatically!

No more extra notebooks or manual cleanup scripts needed.

With the new cloudFiles.cleanSource option, Auto Loader can now handle source files after they’ve been processed:
 🔹 OFF (default): Do nothing
 🔹 DELETE: Remove files after a retention period (default = 30 days)
 🔹 MOVE: Move files to an archive path

Why this matters:
 🔹 Keeps your source directory organized
 🔹 Reduces storage costs
 🔹 Avoids accidental reprocessing
 🔹 Cleanup only starts after a file is successfully processed

✅ New in Databricks Runtime 16.4 LTS

🔗 Details here: https://lnkd.in/eGVA6H9P 

#Databricks #AutoLoader #DataEngineering #Lakehouse #CloudStorage #Streaming #DeltaLake

ai_analysis.summary: Databricks Auto Loader added a cloudFiles.cleanSource option for managing source files after successful processing. The option supports OFF, which performs no cleanup by default; DELETE, which removes files after a retention period that defaults to 30 days; and MOVE, which moves files to an archive path. The post says this reduces the need for separate cleanup notebooks or scripts, organizes source storage, reduces storage costs, and helps avoid accidental reprocessing. The feature is new in Databricks Runtime 16.4 LTS.
subtopics: OFF, DELETE, and MOVE cleanup modes

interview_questions.question: What cleanup modes are available through the cloudFiles.cleanSource option?
interview_questions.answer:
OFF performs no cleanup and is the default mode.
DELETE removes processed files after a retention period that defaults to 30 days.
MOVE moves processed files to an archive path.

interview_questions.question: When does Auto Loader begin cleaning up a source file?
interview_questions.answer: Cleanup begins only after the source file has been successfully processed.

interview_questions.question: Which cleanup mode should be selected when processed files must be retained in an archive location?
interview_questions.answer:
The MOVE mode should be selected because it moves processed files to an archive path.
The answer should contrast MOVE with DELETE, which removes files after the retention period, and OFF, which leaves them in place.

interview_questions.question: What benefits does the post associate with automatic cleanup of processed source files?
interview_questions.answer:
Automatic cleanup keeps the source directory organized and reduces the need for extra notebooks or manual cleanup scripts.
It reduces storage costs and helps avoid accidental reprocessing.
